newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia energy body head is reformist Nemstov ally.
newsitem.headline: Russia energy body head is reformist Nemstov ally.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin has named Andrei Zadernyuk chairman of the Federal Energy Commission, the body which will seek to inject market measures into the energy sector, Itar-Tass news agency said on Friday.
Zadernyuk replaces Yuri Korsun, whom Tass said had been appointed a deputy fuel and energy minister.
Zadernyuk is an ally of reformist Fuel and Energy Minister Boris Nemtsov and held a government post in Nemtsov's former stronghold, Nizhny Novgorod.

The commission, set up by market-minded First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais to introduce competition into the energy sector, is not yet a full-fledged, functioning regulatory agency. Its brief has yet to be fleshed out and it is still unclear how much leeway it will have to liberalise tariff and transport issues.
